evals.prompt: Paint a still life with an oil painting feel. A blue ceramic teapot and a few lemons on a table in front of a dark wall. Use code only, no image generation model.

evals.prompt: In illustration style, draw a cat sitting at a window at sunset, seen from behind as it looks outside. Vertical poster ratio, code-based please.
evals.expected_output: brief.md, scene code scene.py, final PNG after the print texture pass. Built from flat shapes of a limited palette and stipple shading

evals.prompt: Could you draw a full-body adult male swordsman in a cape in anime style? One hand rests on the sword hilt, and the background is a hill at evening sunset. No diffusion model, use codepaint.
evals.expected_output: brief.md, scene code scene.py, final PNG after the compositing pass. An eight-head full figure posed with figure.Figure, the hand touching the sword hilt, two-step cel shading

evals.prompt: Paint an alley after the rain in watercolor. Low houses on both sides and one person with an umbrella at the end of the street. Code only.
evals.expected_output: brief.md, scene code scene.py, final PNG after the watercolor pass. Buildings projected with Perspective, window rows converging on the vanishing point, a figure sized for its depth

evals.prompt: In anime style, draw a cafe window table on a rainy day. An open laptop, a latte cup, a smartphone and an open book. Code only.
evals.expected_output: brief.md, scene code scene.py, final PNG after the compositing pass. Objects made with props and solids share one camera's perspective, and screen and book content attach to faces

evals.prompt: Draw a character sheet of an adult woman in a suit in anime style. A turnaround of front, 3/4, profile and back views plus one pose seated on a chair. Code only.
